decisions.reason: Making the spouts removable for cleaning does not change the valve behavior, flow control, dispensing sequence, or operator-control state.
Spout removability does not alter or negate the existing requirement that the plumbing and bowl bottom remain leak-free.
The removable-cleaning method does not change the requirement to prevent liquid from reaching the base or electrical components.
Removability for cleaning is owned by the cleanable dispensing-path Requirement and does not change the spout's location, orientation, material, or appearance.
Removable spouts do not change the platform height, footprint, or cup-clearance requirement.
The source concerns removable spouts, not whisk detachment or cleaning behavior.
The source confirms a spout cleaning method but does not identify a new component selection or require a BOM revision.
Spout removability does not change the placement of the speed controls, dispense buttons, or master power control.
The removable-spout decision does not change mixing quality, foam performance, whisk geometry, or whisk positioning.
Removability for cleaning does not change the splash target or accepted splash-mitigation methods.
The K-marking clause in the same message is a separate commitment, not a cross-Requirement consequence of making the spouts removable; implementation status must not be propagated here.
The source concerns removable spouts and does not change bowl removal, swapping, or clearance behavior.
